questions.question: Why does AI procurement need more than feature comparison?
options: Because data handling, security, integration, lock-in, and operating cost affect long-term risk
Because vendor demos are always complete
questions.explanation: AI vendor decisions create operating, security, and commercial consequences.

questions.question: Which signal is explicitly part of this lesson?
questions.explanation: Data residency is one vendor evaluation signal.

questions.question: What does the Python artifact produce?
options: A ranked vendor-fit plan with controls and rationale
questions.explanation: The artifact supports evaluation; it does not replace procurement.

questions.question: Which control belongs to this lesson?
questions.explanation: A vendor scorecard makes comparison explicit.

questions.question: When should a vendor decision require stronger controls?
options: When security, data, lock-in, or pricing uncertainty is high
Only when the demo is boring
Only when no integration is needed
Never; vendor selection is only commercial
questions.explanation: High uncertainty and risk require stronger trial and approval controls.

questions.question: What is the purpose of an exit plan?
options: To reduce lock-in risk before committing to a vendor
questions.explanation: Exit planning makes lock-in visible before purchase.
